queries.title: Search keywords
queries.description: Google News search queries (e.g. openai, "climate change"). Combined with site filters and date filters when those are set.

topics.title: Topics
topics.description: Official Google News topic feeds, in addition to keyword searches.

sites.title: Restrict to sites
sites.description: Publisher domains (bbc.com, reuters.com). Applied as site:domain in the search query.

geo.title: Location (optional)
geo.description: Google News geo topic, e.g. California or London. Uses the official geo headlines feed.

includeTopStories.title: Include top stories
includeTopStories.description: Also fetch the Top stories feed for the selected language and country. Used automatically when no query, topic, site or geo is given.

language.title: Language
language.description: ISO language code for Google News (e.g. en, de, fr, ja, es, pt-BR).

country.title: Country
country.description: ISO country code (e.g. US, GB, DE, FR, JP, IN, BR).

when.title: Recency
when.description: Limit keyword/site searches to recent articles (Google's when: operator). Topic feeds are filtered by published date instead.

dateFrom.title: From date (optional)
dateFrom.description: ISO date (YYYY-MM-DD). Added as after: to keyword searches and used as a published-date filter.

dateTo.title: To date (optional)
dateTo.description: ISO date (YYYY-MM-DD). Added as before: to keyword searches and used as a published-date filter.

maxItems.title: Max articles in total
maxItems.description: Hard cap on articles scraped (and charged) in this run. Google News RSS typically returns up to 100 items per feed.

decodeUrls.title: Decode publisher URLs
decodeUrls.description: Resolve news.google.com wrapper links to the real publisher URL (two extra official Google requests per article, no proxy). If decoding fails, the Google News link is kept.

maxConcurrency.title: Max concurrency
maxConcurrency.description: Parallel HTTP requests (feeds and URL decoding).
